action.objective: Win the h5 pawn with Rxh5, keeping the rook active and the R+B endgame edge.
action.rationale: Rxh5 is the sole commit_ready_move: single-candidate verification at depth 4 returned an exact 484 with safety complete (no mating reply) and tactical_refutation not_found. It wins the h5 pawn, raising a clean material edge in the R+B+3P vs R+1P endgame. Broad-search top rows (Rf5? no, Rc5h5 518 at depth 3; Kf1/Kf2 with upper bounds) are shallower or upper-bounded and do not outweigh the deeper exact evidence. After ...Rxa3 Black regains a pawn, but White keeps rook and bishop activity with a safer king.
